findings.claim: A priceless holding is dropped from the coverage line for every reason, so a second gap on the same ticker (unusable setup_type, snapshot_first_seen entry date) is reported nowhere that session.
findings.evidence: engine.py coverage loop `if h.ticker in missing_price_set: continue` skips the whole row; input P priced trend_add, OTH other+entry unpriced, SNAP trend_add snapshot-dated unpriced -> no coverage card at all on HEAD, both named on origin/main.
findings.repro: propose() with that input prints NO COVERAGE CARD on 0679082
findings.acceptance: the coverage card still names OTH's setup_type other and SNAP's tracking-start flag; only the 'no price for this session' clause is suppressed for tickers on the missing-price ALERT; a test asserts a priceless holding with a second gap appears on both cards, each with only its own reason.
findings.resolution: coverage loop filters only the 'no price for this session' clause; other gaps stay named; price-only gap drops off the card

findings.claim: A book where no holding is 'ruled' and every holding is unpriced still exits 0 with 'No proposals'.
findings.evidence: engine.py `ruled` filter + cli.py exit-3 scan finds no card when nothing is ruled; same on origin/main (narrowing of the AC, not a regression).
findings.repro: holdings 1103 {setup_type: other} + 1104 {} with an empty-panel provider -> exit 0
findings.acceptance: exit 3 when a fully unpriced book monitors nothing (price coverage counted over all holdings), or the narrowing stated in the AC.
findings.resolution: ruled filter removed; blind = a fetched session left every holding unpriced; a run that never fetched (prices=None) is never blind (orchestrator probe caught the over-correction at 2d72ce4, fixed in 078fb1c)

findings.claim: The card's 'N of M positions' counts only ruled holdings, under-reporting book size.
findings.evidence: engine.py details total=len(ruled); two-position book prints '1 of 1'.
findings.repro: Holding A entry_price only + Holding B other, prices={} -> 'Price data missing for 1 of 1 positions'
findings.acceptance: M is the holdings count and N the unpriced holdings (not only ruled ones), with a test on a mixed book.
